description_en: Adds applicable personnel to an invoice title
description_zh: 增加发票抬头适用人员
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen add-invoice-entity --third-part-id 4854821 --entities entity_type=1 entity_name=张三 entity_id=12345 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddInvoiceEntity

element_fields.help_en:
The entity type. Valid values:
- 1: employee
- 2: department
- 3: role
- 4: third-party department
element_fields.help_zh: 实体类型：1员工，2部门，3角色，4第三方部门
element_fields.name: entity_type

element_fields.help_en: The entity ID, which can be a personnel ID, department ID, role ID, or third-party department ID
element_fields.help_zh: 实体id：人员id，部门id，角色id，第三方部门id
element_fields.name: entity_id

element_fields.help_en: The entity name, which can be a personnel name, department name, role name, or third-party department name
element_fields.help_zh: 实体名：人员姓名，部门名，角色名，第三方部门名
element_fields.name: entity_name

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise access credential" operation. Add it to the header. In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as a replacement
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
